questions.question:
Find the average of the following sets of numbers.

693, 456, 876, 532, 934, 691, 596, 398, 682
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume a base average of 600 and calculate deviations from it.

Deviations: +93, −144, +276, −68, +334, +91, −4, −202, +82

Sum of deviations = (93 + 276 + 334 + 91 + 82) − (144 + 68 + 4 + 202) = 876 − 418 = 458

Average deviation = 458 ÷ 9 ≈ 50.89

Actual Average = 600 + 50.89 = 650.89

**∴ The correct answer is 650.89.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given observations: 693, 456, 876, 532, 934, 691, 596, 398, 682

Formula used: Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41745a5b1aabf51935adfcd6f9f6149e0c87d71edc40330f088cccb3886910bb.png] 

⇒ Sum = 693 + 456 + 876 + 532 + 934 + 691 + 596 + 398 + 682

⇒ Sum = 5858

⇒ Total count of numbers (n) = 9

⇒ Average = 5858 ÷ 9

⇒ Average = 650.8888...

**∴ The correct answer is 650.89.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Deviations

The sum of the deviations of a set of observations from their arithmetic mean is always zero. ∑(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

Scaling Property

If every observation in a data set is increased/decreased by a constant 'k', the new average also increases/decreases by 'k'.

Combined Average Formula

If two groups have sizes n₁, n₂ and averages a₁, a₂, the combined average is (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: The largest three-digit number that gives the same remainder 2 when divided by 3, 5 and 9 is ________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check the divisibility rule for 5: A number leaving remainder 2 when divided by 5 must end in 2 or 7.

Looking at the options: (1) 999, (2) 984, (3) 998, (4) 992.

Only 992 ends in 2, satisfying the condition for 5.

Verify for 9: Sum of digits of 992 = 9 + 9 + 2 = 20. 20 ÷ 9 leaves remainder 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 992.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Divisors = 3, 5, 9; Common Remainder = 2.

**Formula:** Number = LCM(divisors) × k + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b3ba400e3375feb23115995477ef30d35ea0f5cf874f640e8377eb5a68f3aeb.png] 

⇒ LCM of 3, 5, and 9:

⇒ 3 = 3¹

⇒ 5 = 5¹

⇒ 9 = 3²

⇒ LCM = 3² × 5 = 9 × 5 = 45

⇒ The largest three-digit number is 999.

⇒ Divide 999 by 45: 999 ÷ 45 = 22 with remainder 9.

⇒ Largest multiple of 45 below 1000 = 999 − 9 = 990.

⇒ Required number = 990 + 2 = 992.

**∴ The correct answer is 992.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and Remainder Case 1

When a number is divided by x, y, and z leaving the same remainder R in each case, the number is of the form [LCM(x, y, z) × k] + R.

LCM and Remainder Case 2

When a number leaves different remainders a, b, c such that (x−a) = (y−b) = (z−c) = K, the number is of the form [LCM(x, y, z) × k] − K.

Divisibility Rule of 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 9. The remainder left when the sum is divided by 9 is the same as the remainder of the original number.</p

questions.question: A person can hit a target 5 times out of 8 shots. If he fires 10 shots, what is the probability that he will hit the target twice?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify parameters: n = 10 shots, r = 2 hits, p (hit) = 5/8, q (miss) = 3/8.

Apply Binomial Probability formula: P(X = r) = ⁿCᵣ × pr × qⁿ−r.

Calculation: ¹⁰C₂ × (5/8)² × (3/8)⁸ = 45 × (25/8²) × (3⁸/8⁸).

Simplified result: (45 × 25 × 3⁸) / 8¹⁰ = (1125 × 3⁸) / 8¹⁰.

**∴ The correct answer is (1125 × 3⁸) / 8¹⁰.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total shots (n) = 10

Shots to hit (r) = 2

Probability of hitting (p) = 5/8

Probability of missing (q) = 1 − 5/8 = 3/8

**Formula Used:**

P(X = k) = ⁿCₖ × pk × qⁿ−k

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/301b7669421a16770b33a7993fa3c5ded23e8ee626c63daecd1985b0c1224607.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ ¹⁰C₂ = (10 × 9) / (2 × 1) = 45

⇒ P(X = 2) = 45 × (5/8)² × (3/8)¹⁰−²

⇒ P(X = 2) = 45 × (5² / 8²) × (3⁸ / 8⁸)

⇒ P(X = 2) = 45 × (25 / 8²) × (3⁸ / 8⁸)

⇒ P(X = 2) = (45 × 25 × 3⁸) / 8⁽²⁺⁸⁾

⇒ P(X = 2) = (1125 × 3⁸) / 8¹⁰

**∴ The correct answer is (1125 × 3⁸) / 8¹⁰.**

**__Additional Information__**

Binomial Distribution Conditions

It applies when there are a fixed number of independent trials (n), each with only two possible outcomes (success/failure) and a constant probability of success (p).

Binomial Mean and Variance

The mean of a Binomial distribution is given by μ = np, and the variance is given by σ² = npq, where q = 1 − p.

Combination Formula

The number of ways to choose r successes out of n trials is ⁿCᵣ = n! / [r! × (n−r)!].</p

questions.question: The angle of elevation of the top of a tower from the top of a building whose height is 680 m is 45° and the angle of elevation of the top of same tower from the foot of the same building is 60°. What is the height (in m) of the tower?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In height and distance, for a tower height H and building height h, if angles are θ₁ (from top) and θ₂ (from foot):

H = h × tan(θ₂) ÷ (tan(θ₂) − tan(θ₁))

Given θ₁ = 45°, θ₂ = 60°, h = 680 m

H = 680 × √3 ÷ (√3 − 1) = [680√3 × (√3 + 1)] ÷ [(√3 − 1)(√3 + 1)]

H = 680(3 + √3) ÷ 2 = 340(3 + √3)

**∴ The correct answer is 340(3 + √3) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of building (CD) = 680 m

Angle of elevation from top of building (C) to top of tower (A) = 45°

Angle of elevation from foot of building (D) to top of tower (A) = 60°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cf154696b6333362306d29f15c7cb2b5c764427e46cf46763b926d1621b5423.png] 

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

Let the height of the tower be H and the distance between the building and the tower be x.

In right-angled triangle above the building height:

⇒ tan(45°) = (H − 680) ÷ x

⇒ 1 = (H − 680) ÷ x

⇒ x = H − 680 --- (1)

In right-angled triangle from the foot of the building:

⇒ tan(60°) = H ÷ x

⇒ √3 = H ÷ x

⇒ x = H ÷ √3 --- (2)

Equating (1) and (2):

⇒ H − 680 = H ÷ √3

⇒ H√3 − 680√3 = H

⇒ H(√3 − 1) = 680√3

⇒ H = (680√3) ÷ (√3 − 1)

Rationalizing the denominator:

⇒ H = [680√3 × (√3 + 1)] ÷ [(√3 − 1)(√3 + 1)]

⇒ H = [680(3 + √3)] ÷ (3 − 1)

⇒ H = [680(3 + √3)] ÷ 2

⇒ H = 340(3 + √3)

**∴ The correct answer is 340(3 + √3) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when looking up at an object.

Standard Trigonometric Ratios

tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, tan 60° = √3.

Height and Distance Shortcut

If distances x₁ and x₂ are measured from the foot for angles α and β, then height H = (x₂ − x₁) / (cot α − cot β).</p

questions.question: The median of a set of 11 distinct observations is 73.2. If each of the largest five observations of the set is increased by 3, then the median of the new set:

options.text: is 3 times that of the original set
remains the same as that of the original set

In a set of 11 observations, the median is the 6th term when arranged in ascending order.

The largest five observations are the 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, and 11th terms.

Increasing values that are already larger than the median does not change the position or value of the median (the 6th term).

Since the 6th term remains 73.2, the median of the new set remains unchanged.

**∴ The correct answer is remains the same as that of the original set.**

**Given:**

Total observations (n) = 11

Original Median = 73.2

⇒ New observations = x₁, x₂, x₃, x₄, x₅, x₆, (x₇+3), (x₈+3), (x₉+3), (x₁₀+3), (x₁₁+3).

⇒ Since x₆ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Odd vs Even n

If n is odd, Median = ((n+1)/2)th term. If n is even, Median = Average of (n/2)th and ((n/2)+1)th terms.

Property of Median

The median is not affected by extreme values or changes in values that do not cross the central position in the ordered list.

Effect of Linear Changes

If every observation in a set is increased by a constant k, the median also increases by k. However, if only specific observations are changed, the median may or may not change depending on their position.</p

questions.question: In a trapezium ABCD, AD and BC are parallel to each other with a perpendicular distance of 8 m between them. Also, (AB) = (CD) = 10 m, and (AD) = 15 m, (AD) < (BC). What is the perimeter (in m) of the trapezium ABCD?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an isosceles trapezium where AB = CD and AD || BC:

Bottom Base (BC) = AD + 2 × √(Slant Side² − Height²)

BC = 15 + 2 × √(10² − 8²) = 15 + 2 × 6 = 27 m

Perimeter = Sum of all sides = AD + BC + AB + CD

Perimeter = 15 + 27 + 10 + 10 = 62 m

**∴ The correct answer is 62 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** AD = 15 m, AB = 10 m, CD = 10 m, and Height (h) = 8 m.

**Formula:** Perimeter = AD + BC + AB + CD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ed9cc19d3a42c7844075d2bde9183566bda603d49953c47d7f24dc94f2def66.png] 

In the trapezium ABCD, let's drop perpendiculars AM and DN on base BC.

⇒ AM = DN = 8 m (Height)

⇒ In right-angled triangle AMB, by Pythagoras theorem:

⇒ BM² = AB² − AM²

⇒ BM² = 10² − 8² = 100 − 64 = 36

⇒ BM = 6 m

⇒ Since the trapezium is isosceles (AB = CD), BM = NC = 6 m.

⇒ Length of base BC = BM + MN + NC

⇒ As MN = AD, BC = 6 + 15 + 6 = 27 m

⇒ Perimeter of ABCD = AB + BC + CD + DA

⇒ Perimeter = 10 + 27 + 10 + 15

⇒ Perimeter = 62 m

**∴ The correct answer is 62 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Trapezium

The area of a trapezium is calculated as Area = 1/2 × (sum of parallel sides) × height = 1/2 × (a + b) × h.

Isosceles Trapezium Properties

In an isosceles trapezium, the non-parallel sides are equal, the base angles are equal, and the diagonals are equal in length.

Median of a Trapezium

The median (or midsegment) of a trapezium is parallel to the bases and its length is the average of the base lengths: Median = (a + b) / 2.</p

questions.question: A prism and a pyramid have the same base and the same height. Find the ratio of the volumes of the prism and the pyramid.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**3 : 1**__
**__Key Points__**
__

• The **Volume of a Prism** is calculated by multiplying the **Base Area** (A) by the **Vertical Height** (h). The formula is given as: **Vₚᵣᵢₛₘ = Base Area × Height**.

• The **Volume of a Pyramid** is exactly one-third of the volume of a prism that has the same **Base Area** and **Height**. The formula is given as: **Vₚyᵣₐₘᵢd = (1/3) × Base Area × Height**.

• In this problem, it is stated that both the **Prism** and the **Pyramid** share the same **Base Area** (let it be **'A'**) and the same **Height** (let it be **'h'**).

• To find the **Ratio** of their volumes, we set up the expression: **Volume of Prism : Volume of Pyramid**.

• Substituting the formulas: **(A × h) : ((1/3) × A × h)**.

• By simplifying the expression and dividing both sides by **(A × h)**, we get **1 : 1/3**.

• Multiplying both sides by **3** to clear the fraction, the ratio becomes **3 : 1**.

• Therefore, the volume of a prism is **three times** the volume of a pyramid with the same base and height.

**Additional Information__**

• A **Prism** is a three-dimensional solid with two **congruent** and **parallel** bases. The lateral faces are typically **parallelograms** (or rectangles in a right prism).

• A **Pyramid** is a three-dimensional solid with a **polygonal base** and triangular lateral faces that meet at a single point called the **Apex**.

• The relationship **Vₚᵣᵢₛₘ = 3 × Vₚyᵣₐₘᵢd** holds true regardless of the shape of the base (triangle, square, hexagon, etc.), as long as the base and height are identical for both solids.

• Similarly, the volume of a **Cylinder** is three times the volume of a **Cone** if they have the same **radius** and **height**.

questions.question: If two LED TVs and one mobile phone cost ₹31,000, while two mobile phones and one LED TV cost ₹35,000, then the value of one mobile phone is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total cost of 3 LED TVs and 3 Mobiles = 31,000 + 35,000 = 66,000

⇒ 1 LED TV + 1 Mobile = 66,000 ÷ 3 = 22,000

Given: 1 LED TV + 2 Mobiles = 35,000

⇒ 1 Mobile = (1 LED TV + 2 Mobiles) − (1 LED TV + 1 Mobile) = 35,000 − 22,000 = 13,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given values:

Cost of 2 LED TVs + 1 Mobile = ₹31,000

Cost of 1 LED TV + 2 Mobiles = ₹35,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5304d38705cb50f0305f2ec034dc34d1de5896a07ef4c68d4eba0d2eb6c960d.png] 

Let the cost of one LED TV be T and the cost of one Mobile be M.

Equation 1: 2T + M = 31,000

Equation 2: T + 2M = 35,000

⇒ Multiply Equation 2 by 2:

⇒ 2(T + 2M) = 2 × 35,000

⇒ 2T + 4M = 70,000 --- (Equation 3)

⇒ Subtract Equation 1 from Equation 3:

⇒ (2T + 4M) − (2T + M) = 70,000 − 31,000

⇒ 3M = 39,000

⇒ M = 39,000 ÷ 3

⇒ M = 13,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Elimination Method

Variables are eliminated by making the coefficients of one variable equal in both equations through multiplication.

Substitution Method

Express one variable in terms of the other from one equation and substitute it into the second equation.

System of Linear Equations

A set of two or more equations with the same variables. For two variables x and y, the general form is a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cylinder if the radius of the cylinder is 10 cm and height is 20 cm? (Take π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a cylinder is given by the formula πr²h.

Given: r = 10 cm, h = 20 cm, π = 3.14

Direct Calculation: 3.14 × 10 × 10 × 20

⇒ 314 × 20 = 6280 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 6280 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of cylinder (r) = 10 cm

Height of cylinder (h) = 20 cm

Value of π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39d0c8a415a08eecea11fc0143cc9fee95f150e6bbc1e2b701c90ee813e758c6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × (10)² × 20

⇒ Volume = 3.14 × 100 × 20

⇒ Volume = 314 × 20

⇒ Volume = 6280 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 6280 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The curved surface area of a cylinder is given by the formula 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total surface area of a cylinder includes both the curved area and the two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same radius and height as a cylinder has exactly one-third of its volume: V = (1/3)πr²h.</p

questions.question: P, Q, and R can finish a work in 5 days, 10 days, and 15 days, respectively, working alone. P and Q work on the first day, P and R work on the second day and P and Q work on the third day, and so on till the work is completed. In how many days the work will be completed?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(5, 10, 15) = 30 units.

Efficiencies: P = 6, Q = 3, R = 2.

Day 1 (P+Q) = 9 units; Day 2 (P+R) = 8 units.

In 2 days, work completed = 9 + 8 = 17 units.

Day 3 (P+Q) = 9 units; Total after 3 days = 17 + 9 = 26 units.

Remaining 4 units done by (P+R) on Day 4 in 4 ÷ 8 = 1/2 day.

**∴ The correct answer is 7/2 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by P = 5 days

Time taken by Q = 10 days

Time taken by R = 15 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of individual time periods

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P

 10

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work = 30 units

⇒ Work on Day 1 (P + Q) = 6 + 3 = 9 units

⇒ Work on Day 2 (P + R) = 6 + 2 = 8 units

⇒ Combined work in first 2 days = 9 + 8 = 17 units

⇒ Remaining work after 2 days = 30 − 17 = 13 units

⇒ Work on Day 3 (P + Q) = 9 units

⇒ Remaining work after 3 days = 13 − 9 = 4 units

⇒ Efficiency of (P + R) on Day 4 = 6 + 2 = 8 units/day

⇒ Time taken for remaining 4 units = 4 ÷ 8 = 1/2 day

⇒ Total time = 3 + 1/2 = 7/2 days

**∴ The correct answer is 7/2 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alternate Day Work Concept

When people work on alternate days, identify the work done in one complete cycle and then calculate the number of full cycles that fit into the total work.

Work and Wages

If a group of people work together or on alternate days, the total wages are always distributed in the ratio of the actual units of work done by each individual.

Pipes and Cisterns

Similar to time and work, but if a pipe empties the tank, its efficiency is taken as negative. Total capacity is found using LCM of the time taken by individual pipes.</p

questions.question: A goods train 350 m long passes through a tunnel of length 1250 m in 80 seconds. What is the speed of the train?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance to cover = Length of Train + Length of Tunnel = 350 + 1250 = 1600 m

Speed (in m/s) = Total Distance ÷ Time = 1600 ÷ 80 = 20 m/s

To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5:

Speed (in km/h) = 20 × (18 ÷ 5) = 4 × 18 = 72 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 72 km/h.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the goods train (LT) = 350 m

Length of the tunnel (LP) = 1250 m

Time taken (t) = 80 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = Length of Train + Length of Tunnel

Speed (km/h) = Speed (m/s) × (18 ÷ 5)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e23474f515a5fe090ee2919142b697ac0953628fd2d95ec62cfc62f54d989455.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 350 + 1250 = 1600 m

⇒ Speed in m/s = 1600 ÷ 80

⇒ Speed in m/s = 20 m/s

⇒ Speed in km/h = 20 × (18 ÷ 5)

⇒ Speed in km/h = 4 × 18

⇒ Speed in km/h = 72 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 72 km/h.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed Conversion Rules

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Train Crossing Stationary Objects

When a train crosses a stationary point object (pole, tree, man), distance = length of train. When it crosses an object with length (bridge, platform, tunnel), distance = length of train + length of object.

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.</p

questions.question: If one of the interior angles of a regular polygon is (15)/(16) times of one of the interior angles of a regular decagon, then find the number of diagonals of the polygon.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interior angle of a decagon (10 sides) = (10 − 2) × 180° ÷ 10 = 144°.

Interior angle of the polygon = 15/16 × 144° = 15 × 9° = 135°.

Exterior angle = 180° − 135° = 45°.

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ 45° = 8.

Number of diagonals = n(n − 3) ÷ 2 = 8 × 5 ÷ 2 = 20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Divisibility Rule of 7

Subtract twice the last digit from the rest of the number. If the result is 0 or a multiple of 7, the original number is divisible by 7.

Divisibility Rule of 11

The difference between the sum of digits at odd places and the sum of digits at even places must be either 0 or a multiple of 11.

Divisibility Rule of 13

Add four times the last digit to the remaining number. If the sum is divisible by 13, the original number is divisible by 13.</p

questions.question: If a cot θ + b cosec θ = p and b cot θ + a cosec θ = q then p² - q² is equal to _________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume a specific value for θ to simplify the calculation, let θ = 90°.

Then, cot 90° = 0 and cosec 90° = 1.

Substitute these values: p = a(0) + b(1) = b and q = b(0) + a(1) = a.

Now, calculate p² − q² = b² − a².

**∴ The correct answer is b² − a².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

p = a cot θ + b cosec θ

q = b cot θ + a cosec θ

**Formula Used:**

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1deb6edc701424e631b58500b9b9a03604ace626509ace60b71d44c1a0659e8f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ p² = (a cot θ + b cosec θ)²

⇒ p² = a² cot² θ + b² cosec² θ + 2ab cot θ cosec θ ----(1)

⇒ q² = (b cot θ + a cosec θ)²

⇒ q² = b² cot² θ + a² cosec² θ + 2ab cot θ cosec θ ----(2)

⇒ Subtracting (2) from (1):

⇒ p² − q² = (a² − b²) cot² θ + (b² − a²) cosec² θ

⇒ p² − q² = −(b² − a²) cot² θ + (b² − a²) cosec² θ

⇒ p² − q² = (b² − a²) (cosec² θ − cot² θ)

⇒ Since cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1,

⇒ p² − q² = (b² − a²)(1)

**∴ The correct answer is b² − a².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Pythagorean Identities

Standard identities used in simplification: sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, sec² θ − tan² θ = 1, and cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Value Substitution Method

This method is highly effective in MCQ exams for identities. Common values used are 0°, 45°, and 90°, provided the function is defined at that point.

Reciprocal Relations

cosec θ = 1 ÷ sin θ and cot θ = cos θ ÷ sin θ.</p

questions.question: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral. If ∠P is three times of ∠R and ∠S is four times of ∠Q, then the sum of ∠S + ∠R will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of opposite angles: ∠P : ∠R = 3 : 1 ⇒ Total 4 units = 180°

Value of ∠R = 1 unit = 180° ÷ 4 = 45°

Ratio of opposite angles: ∠S : ∠Q = 4 : 1 ⇒ Total 5 units = 180°

Value of ∠S = 4 units = (180° ÷ 5) × 4 = 144°

Sum ∠S + ∠R = 144° + 45° = 189°

**∴ The correct answer is 189°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral PQRS is cyclic.

∠P = 3 × ∠R

∠S = 4 × ∠Q

**Formula Used:**

In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles is 180°.

∠P + ∠R = 180°

∠Q + ∠S = 180°

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4abf6994ea48a35281374c1889cd34c3a17ab8a9799cadb6f9df5b939d416519.png] 

**Calculations:**

Case 1: ∠P and ∠R are opposite angles.

⇒ ∠P + ∠R = 180°

⇒ 3∠R + ∠R = 180°

⇒ 4∠R = 180°

⇒ ∠R = 45°

Case 2: ∠S and ∠Q are opposite angles.

⇒ ∠S + ∠Q = 180°

⇒ ∠S + (∠S ÷ 4) = 180°

⇒ (5 × ∠S) ÷ 4 = 180°

⇒ 5∠S = 720°

⇒ ∠S = 144°

Now, finding the required sum:

⇒ Sum = ∠S + ∠R

⇒ Sum = 144° + 45°

⇒ Sum = 189°

**∴ The correct answer is 189°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

A quadrilateral is called cyclic if all its four vertices lie on a circle. The sum of any pair of opposite angles is 180°.

Exterior Angle of Cyclic Quadrilateral

The exterior angle formed by extending one side of a cyclic quadrilateral is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Ptolemy's Theorem

For a cyclic quadrilateral with sides a, b, c, d and diagonals p, q, the product of the diagonals is equal to the sum of the products of opposite sides: p × q = (a × c) + (b × d).</p

questions.question: Working for 10 hours per day, 6 men can build a wall in a certain number of days. By working for how many hours per day can 12 men build the wall in the same days?

For a fixed amount of work, the number of workers is inversely proportional to the time taken (Days or Hours). If workers double, time taken is halved.

Total Work is often measured in Man-Hours or Man-Days. Total Work = Number of Men × Number of Days × Hours per day.</p

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?

⇒ Sum of even-position digits = 2 + 4 + 4 = 10

Divisibility by 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 (or 9) if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 3 (or 9).

Divisibility by 7

Subtract twice the last digit from the number formed by the remaining digits; the result should be divisible by 7.

Divisibility by 13

questions.question: It is given that ∆ABC ≅ ∆PQR, AB = 5 cm, ∠B = 40°, and ∠A = 80°. Which of the following options is true?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Congruent triangles ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR means corresponding sides and angles are equal.

Side AB corresponds to side PQ ⇒ PQ = AB = 5 cm.

In ΔABC, ∠C = 180° − (∠A + ∠B) = 180° − (80° + 40°) = 60°.

∠R corresponds to ∠C ⇒ ∠R = ∠C = 60°.

**∴ The correct answer is PQ = 5 cm and ∠R = 60°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR, AB = 5 cm, ∠B = 40°, ∠A = 80°.

**Formula:** Angle sum property of a triangle (∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°) and CPCT (Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/144298b4e113d1bcb9b049dc967fe493aa8eed644ea2eeaa07971489daf6cbde.png] 

⇒ In ΔABC, sum of angles = 180°

⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 80° + 40° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 120° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = 60°

⇒ Since ΔABC ≅ ΔPQR, by CPCT:

⇒ PQ = AB = 5 cm

⇒ ∠P = ∠A = 80°, ∠Q = ∠B = 40°, ∠R = ∠C = 60°

**∴ The correct answer is PQ = 5 cm and ∠R = 60°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Congruence Rule (CPCT)

CPCT stands for Corresponding Parts of Congruent Triangles. If two triangles are congruent, then all their corresponding sides and angles are equal.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always 180°. If two angles are known, the third can be found as 180° − (Sum of known angles).

Criteria for Congruence

Two triangles can be proven congruent using SSS (Side-Side-Side), SAS (Side-Angle-Side), ASA (Angle-Side-Angle), AAS (Angle-Angle-Side), or RHS (Right angle-Hypotenuse-Side).</p

questions.question: How many kilogram of rice costing Rs. 60 per kg must be mixed with 24 kg of rice costing Rs. 42 per kg so that there may be a gain of 12% by selling the mixture at Rs. 56 per kg?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Find Cost Price (CP) of mixture: 56 ÷ 1.12 = ₹50/kg.

Apply Alligation ratio (Type 1 : Type 2) = (50 − 42) : (60 − 50) = 8 : 10 = 4 : 5.

Compare units: 5 units correspond to 24 kg.

Calculate Type 1: (24 ÷ 5) × 4 = 19.2 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 19.2 kg.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of first variety (Rice₁) = ₹60/kg

CP of second variety (Rice₂) = ₹42/kg

Quantity of second variety (Q₂) = 24 kg

Selling Price of mixture (SPₘᵢₓ) = ₹56/kg

Profit percentage = 12%

**Formula Used:**

CP = (SP × 100) ÷ (100 + Profit%)

Alligation Rule: (Quantity₁) ÷ (Quantity₂) = (Mean Price − CP₂) ÷ (CP₁ − Mean Price)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24bb577a761ad60985eaf2f4bac0327ae9087bc7b4c6b4fd2167b7bacc1f3af8.png] 

⇒ Mean CP of Mixture = (56 × 100) ÷ (100 + 12)

⇒ Mean CP = 5600 ÷ 112 = ₹50/kg

⇒ Applying Alligation: Q₁ ÷ Q₂ = (50 − 42) ÷ (60 − 50)

⇒ Q₁ ÷ 24 = 8 ÷ 10

⇒ Q₁ ÷ 24 = 4 ÷ 5

⇒ Q₁ = (4 × 24) ÷ 5

⇒ Q₁ = 96 ÷ 5 = 19.2 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 19.2 kg.**

**__Additional Information__**

Alligation Method

Used to find the ratio in which two ingredients with different costs must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired average cost.

Cost Price from Selling Price

Always calculate the CP of the mixture before using the Alligation rule if only the SP and profit/loss % are provided: CP = SP ÷ (1 ± r/100).

Weighted Average Formula

The mean price can also be verified using: Mean Price = (n₁c₁ + n₂c₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is quantity and c is cost.

**Formula Used:** (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab; sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4c99d02a47fb7cbdf27c569996d65320131564390dfd75b55dafaf93de5ca73.png]

⇒ sin²θ + cosec²θ + 2(1) + cos²θ + sec²θ + 2(1)

Grouping the terms:

⇒ (sin²θ + cos²θ) + cosec²θ + sec²θ + 4

⇒ 1 + (1 + cot²θ) + (1 + tan²θ) + 4

⇒ 1 + 1 + cot²θ + 1 + tan²θ + 4

⇒ 7 + tan²θ + cot²θ

**∴ The correct answer is 7 + tan²θ + cot²θ.**

Fundamental Trigonometric Identities

Reciprocal Relations

cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ. Their products (e.g., sin θ × cosec θ) are always equal to 1.

The correct answer is __**Rigveda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Bharatas were the Vedic tribe mentioned in Rigveda. The name Bharata was used for a group of people who lived in the northwest, and who are mentioned in the Rigveda, the earliest composition in Sanskrit. Later it was used for the country.

__
 
• Vedic Period__

 __
 
• It is the period in the late Bronze age and early Iron Age of the History of India when the Vedas were composed in the northern Indian subcontinent.
 
• The associated culture was referred to as Vedic Civilization.
 
• The entire Earth was called the Bharatvarsha but in particular, the area that lied south to the Himalayan Mountain was called the Bharatvarsha.
 
• The Bharatvarsha was also known as Aryavarta meaning the land of Aryans.
 
• Aryavarta and Bharat are mentioned in Vedas, many scriptures, and Mahabharata.
 
• Bharatas were the Vedic tribe mentioned in Rigveda.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rig Veda: 

 
 
• The **oldest Veda** is the Rigveda.
 
• It has **1028 hymns** called ‘**Suktas’** and is a collection of 10 books called **Mandalas**.
 
• The meaning of the word ‘Rigveda’ is **Praise Knowledge**. 
 
• Rigvedic books 2-9 deal with cosmology and deities.
 
• Rigvedic books 1 and 10 deal with philosophical questions and also talk about various virtues including charity in society. 
 
• The meters used to form hymns are Gayatri, Anushtubh, Trishtubh, and Jagati (**Trishtubh and Gayatri are most important**).
 
 
 
• Sama Veda:
 
 
• Known as the Veda of** melodies **and** chants**, Samaveda dates back to **1200-800 BCE**.
 
• This Veda is related to public worship. T
 
• here are **1549 verses **(except 75 verses, all have been taken from Rigveda). 
 
• There are two Upanishads embedded in Samaveda – **Chandogya Upanishad** and **Kena Upanishad**.
 
• Samaveda Samhita is not meant to be read as a text, it is like a musical score sheet that must be heard. 
 
 
 
• ​Yajur Veda:
 
 
• Stands to mean ‘**Worship Knowledge**’.
 
• Yajurveda dates back to **1100-800 BCE**.
 
• It compiles ritual-offering mantras/chants. These chants were offered by the priest alongside a person who used to perform a ritual (in most cases yajna fire.)
 
• It has two types –** Krishna **(Black/Dark) & Shukla (White/Bright). Krishna Yajurveda has an un-arranged, unclear, motley collection of verses and Shukla Yajurveda has arranged and clear verses.
 
 
 
• ​Atharva Veda:
 
 
• Stands to mean a tatpurusha compound of Atharvan, an ancient sage, and knowledge.
 
• It dates back to** 1000-800 BCE**.
 
• It has **730 hymns/suktas,** **6000** mantras, and **20 books**.

questions.question: What do you call the drugs that bind to the receptor site and inhibit its natural function?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Antagonists**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antagonists**

 
 
• **Drugs that bind to the receptor site and inhibit its natural function are called Antagonists.**
 
• Antagonists and agonists act differently.
 
• Agonists combine with the receptor molecule and produce a biological response but antagonists combine with the receptors and inhibit their natural function.
 
• Enzyme inhibitors inhibit the catalytic activity of the enzyme. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antidepressants**

 
 
• Antidepressants are **medications** prescribed to treat various forms of **depression **and** anxiety disorders**.
 
• They work by affecting neurotransmitters in the brain, such as **serotonin, norepinephrine, **and **dopamine**, which play a role in mood regulation. 
 
 
 
• **Agonist**
 
 
• An agonist is a molecule or compound that activates a receptor, leading to a physiological or pharmacological response in a **cell or organism**.
 
• Agonists can be naturally occurring, like **hormones** or **neurotransmitters**, or** synthetic**, like **drugs**. 
 
 
 
• **Depressants**
 
 
• Depressants are substances that slow down the **central nervous system** (CNS),** reducing neural activity **and** leading to relaxation**,** drowsiness**, and **decreased alertness**.
 
• They can have therapeutic uses, such as treating **anxiety**,** insomnia**, and** muscle spasms**.
 
• Common depressants include alcohol, benzodiazepines (e.g., **Valium, Xanax**), barbiturates, and certain sleep medications.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements is/are CORRECT with respect to Draft Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, proposed in 2022?

A. Online games will have to register with a self-regulatory body, and only games cleared by the body will be allowed to legally operate in India.

B. Online gaming companies will not be allowed to engage in betting on the outcome of games, the proposed rules say.

C. According to the rules, there could be more than one self-regulatory body.
questions.solution:
Correct Answer **A, B and C**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MEITY) **has **released the draft rules **pertaining to **online gaming **by amending the **Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021. **
 
• These rules are **released by MEITY** for the comments of the public and shall remain open for such comments till **17th Jan. 2023.**
 
• he proposed rules add definitions for **online games and online gaming intermediaries** and put restrictions on games related to **betting, gambling, or the participation of minors.**
 
• **Online gaming **intermediaries will need to register with a **self-regulatory body,** which must be registered with the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology**, and must display their registration details on their website or mobile application.
 
• The **self-regulatory body **will be composed of several individuals with different backgrounds, and the online gaming intermediary must display a visible mark of registration on all online games registered by the **self-regulatory body.**
 
• Gaming companies will also have to secure a Random Number Generation Certificate to ensure game outputs are statistically random and unpredictable, and a **"no bot certificate" **from a reputed certifying body.
 
• Online intermediaries will be required to identify and verify the identity of the user **(KYC**) while starting a user account-based relationship.
 
• They will also need to appoint a **Chief Compliance Officer,** a nodal contact person, and publish a physical contact address in India on their website or mobile application.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Why in the news?

 
• Social media platforms and other intermediaries on the Internet are now required to remove PIB-flagged fake news articles about the Union Government from their platforms.
 
• The new amendment of the IT Rules means that Social media platforms will no longer enjoy legal immunity on content posted by their users.
 
 
• Platforms can now be called as a party in court proceedings. *Hence statement 1 is correct*.
 
• Minister of State for Electronics and Information Technology said that platforms will not be required to take down content due to this Rule alone, but they will not enjoy the legal immunity that they currently benefit from for content posted by their users. They can now be called as a party in court proceedings.
 
 
 
• The changes were notified through the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2023, amending the IT Rules, 2021.

Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Amendment Rules, 2023:

 
• Social Media Platforms:

 
 
• The rules require social media platforms with a certain number of users in the country to establish a physical presence, including a registered office, in the country.
 
• This aims to ensure that these platforms are more accountable to the laws and regulations of the country and can be held liable for any content that violates the rules.
 
 
 
• Content Removal and Traceability:
 
 
• The rules mandate social media platforms to remove or disable access to any unlawful content or information.a
 
• They are also required to maintain records of the origin of information, which can be used to trace the originator of any unlawful content.
 
• This is aimed at combating the spread of fake news, misinformation, and illegal content online.
 
 
 
• User verification:
 
 
• Social media intermediaries are required to take measures to verify the identity of their users, especially for significant social media intermediaries.
 
 
 
• Voluntary user verification:
 
 
• The IT Rules now allow for voluntary user verification, which means users have the option to verify their accounts with social media intermediaries using government-issued ID proofs.
 
 
 
• Emergency blocking of content:
 
 
• In cases where there is an emergency situation that threatens public order, the government can direct social media intermediaries to block access to certain content within 24 hours.
 
 
 
• Data retention:
 
 
• Social media intermediaries are required to retain user data for 180 days for investigation and prevention of cybersecurity incidents, and they are also required to provide information to the government agencies as and when requested.
 
 
 
• Grievance Redressal Mechanism:
 
 
• Social media platforms are required to establish a grievance redressal mechanism to address complaints from users and resolve them in a timely manner.
 
• This aims to provide users with a channel to report objectionable content and seek remedies for any violations of their rights.
 
 
 
• Code of Ethics for Digital Media:
 
 
• The rules introduce a code of ethics for digital media, including online news portals and OTT (Over-The-Top) platforms.
 
• This code includes guidelines related to the portrayal of prohibited content, journalistic conduct, and user-generated content.
 
• Digital media platforms are required to classify their content into appropriate categories and follow the prescribed code of ethics.
 
 
 
• Self-Regulatory Body:
 
 
• The rules provide for the establishment of a self-regulatory body by digital media platforms, which will oversee the implementation of the code of ethics and address grievances related to digital media. *Hence statement 2 is correct*.
 
• This self-regulatory body will be required to register with the government and comply with certain guidelines.
 
 
 
• Government Oversight:
 
 
• The rules also give the government the authority to issue directions to social media platforms and digital media platforms for compliance with the rules.
 
• Failure to comply with these directions can result in penalties and other legal consequences.

Which of the following is/are one of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals?

(A) Zero Hunger

(B) Climate Action

(C) Life Below Water

(D) Quality Education
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **A, B, C and D **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__** Sustainable Development Goals: 

__
 
• The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) or Global Goals are a collection of 17 interlinked global goals designed to be a "blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all".
 
• The SDGs were set up in 2015 by the United Nations General Assembly and are intended to be achieved by the year 2030. 

17 interlinked global goals are as follows: 

 
• Goal 1. End poverty in all its forms everywhere
 
• Goal 2 End hunger achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
 
• Goal 3 Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
 
• Goal 4 Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all
 
• Goal5. Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
 
• Goal 6 Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
 
• Goal 7 Ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all
 
• Goal 8 Promote sustained inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
 
• Goal 9 Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation
 
• Goal 10 Reduce inequality within and among countries
 
• Goal 11 Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
 
• Goal 12.Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns
 
• Goal 13 Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts
 
• Goal 14 Conserve and sustainably use the oceans, seas and marine resources for sustainable development
 
• Goal 15 Protect, restore and promote sustainable use of terrestrial ecosystems, sustainably manage forests, combat desertification, and haltand+ reverse land degradation and halt biodiversity loss
 
• Goal 16 Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels
 
• Goal 17. Strengthen the means of implementation and revitalize the Global Partnership for Sustainable Development.
 
• Each goal typically has 8–12 targets, and each target has between 1 and 4 indicators used to measure progress toward reaching the targets. The targets are either "outcome" targets (circumstances to be attained) or "means of implementation" targets. The latter targets were introduced late in the process of negotiating the SDGs to address the concern of some Member States about how the SDGs were to be achieved. Goal 17 is wholly about how the SDGs will be achieved.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The 17 SDGs are (1) No Poverty, (2) Zero Hunger, (3) Good Health and Well-being, (4) Quality Education, (5) Gender Equality, (6) Clean Water and Sanitation, (7) Affordable and Clean Energy, (8) Decent Work and Economic Growth, (9) Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, (10) Reducing Inequality, (11) Sustainable Cities and Communities, (12) Responsible Consumption and Production, (13) Climate Action, (14) Life Below Water, (15) Life On Land, (16) Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions, (17) Partnerships for the Goals.

questions.question: Which crops are benefitted from the temperate cyclones arising from the Mediterranean Sea that cause rainfall in Punjab?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabi crops**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In northwestern India, some weak temperate cyclones from the Mediterranean sea cause rainfall in Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, and western Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The western cyclonic disturbances which enter the Indian subcontinent from the west and the northwest during the winter months, originate over the Mediterranean Sea and are brought into India by the westerly jet stream.
 
• Although the amount is meager, it is highly beneficial for rabi crops.
 
• The precipitation is in the form of snowfall in the lower Himalayas.
 
• It is this snow that sustains the flow of water in the Himalayan rivers during the summer months.
 
• The precipitation goes on decreasing from west to east in the plains and from north to south in the mountains.
 
• The average winter rainfall in Delhi is around 53 mm.
 
• In Punjab and Bihar, rainfall remains between 25 mm and 18 mm respectively.
 
• During October and November, the northeast monsoon while crossing over the Bay of Bengal picks up moisture and causes torrential rainfall over the Tamil Nadu coast, southern Andhra Pradesh, southeast Karnataka, and southeast Kerala.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• The period from June to September is referred to as the 'Southwest Monsoon' period.
 
• The Southwest Monsoon period is the principal rainy season for the Indian subcontinent. 
 
• This is the summer monsoon period where the southwest monsoon holds away over the country. 
 
• The whole country receives nearly 75% of its rainfall during this period.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the Supreme Court judgement on validity of 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act?

A. The Supreme Court of India’s Constitutional Bench for this case consisted of 5 judges.

B. The Constitutional Bench upholds the 10% of EWS reservation with 3-2 majority.

C. As per the Supreme Court judgement, the 103rd Constitutional Amendment is valid although it is violating the Basic Structure of the Indian Constitution.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**A and B only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act was passed in January 2019 and it provided for a 10% reservation in government jobs and educational institutions for economically weaker sections (EWS) of the society who are not covered under existing reservations for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Other Backward Classes.
 
• The main argument against the Amendment was that it violates the basic structure of the Constitution, which includes the principle of equality and the principle of reservation as enshrined in the Constitution.
 
• In a landmark judgement delivered on May 5, 2021, a Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court upheld the validity of the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act.
 
• The Bench comprised of 5 Justices Ashok Bhushan, L Nageswara Rao, S Abdul Nazeer, Hemant Gupta, and S Ravindra Bhat.
 
• The Supreme Court held that the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act does not violate the basic structure of the Constitution.
 
• The Court held that the principle of reservation is not an immutable feature of the Constitution and that the State has the power to provide for reservation to any socially and educationally backward class of citizens.
 
• The Court also held that the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act is a valid exercise of the State's power to provide for reservation.
 
• The Constitutional Bench upholds the 10% of EWS reservation with 3-2 majority.
 
• The Supreme Court also held that the 10% reservation for EWS provided under the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act is not limited to any particular religion or caste and is available to all those who are economically backward and do not fall within the scope of the existing reservations for SCs, STs, and OBCs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 This amendment provided constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) and devolved powers and functions to them. It also reserved seats for women and Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in the PRIs.

questions.question: Who found an empirical relationship between the half-life of alpha decay and the energy of the emitted alpha particles in 1911?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Geiger and Nuttall.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1911, the New Zealand physicist Ernest Rutherford, along with his colleagues Hans Geiger and Ernest Marsden, conducted the famous gold foil experiment, which led to the discovery of the atomic nucleus.
 
• During this experiment, they also found an empirical relationship between the half-life of alpha decay and the energy of the emitted alpha particles. This relationship is now known as the Rutherford's law of radioactive decay.
 
• The law states that the rate of alpha decay is directly proportional to the energy of the emitted alpha particles.
 
• Specifically, the law states that the logarithm of the half-life of alpha decay is linearly related to the logarithm of the energy of the emitted alpha particles.
 
• The law has been found to hold true for a wide range of alpha decay processes and has been an important tool for understanding the behavior of radioactive elements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• A continental climate is characterized by extreme temperatures, with hot summers and cold winters.
 
• The absence of large water bodies means that these states do not experience the moderating effect of the sea, which helps to keep temperatures moderate and stable.

• This is because cold air is transported from the higher altitude regions to the lower altitude areas, leading to a drop in temperature.

• **The cold air mass** moves downwards due to the force of gravity, causing the temperature to fall rapidly.
 
 
 
• **The Western Disturbance is a cyclonic storm that originates in the Mediterranean region and moves towards India, bringing with it cold air from the Caspian Sea and Turkmenistan.**
 
 
• This weather pattern can result in heavy snowfall in the higher altitudes of the Himalayas and cause a drop in temperature in the plains, leading to frost and fog in some areas.

Spyware: Spyware is a type of malicious software or malware that is installed on a computing device without the end user's knowledge.

Keyloggers Characteristics:

 
• Keyloggers are a type of malware.
 
• Keyloggers are a particularly insidious type of spyware that can record and steal consecutive keystrokes (and much more) that the user enters on a device.
 
• The term keylogger, or "keystroke logger," is self-explanatory: Software that logs what you type on your keyboard.
 
• However, keyloggers can also enable cybercriminals to eavesdrop on you, watch you on your system camera, or listen over your smartphone's microphone.
 
• Keyloggers may be used for a number of objectives, including fraudulently gaining access to your private information and monitoring staff actions. Some keyloggers may also record your screen at random intervals; these are known as screen recorders.
 
• A keylogger is a malicious computer application that records everything you write on the keyboard and learns the keystroke pattern, including words, characters, and symbols, and then sends all of the recorded information to hostile hackers.

Hence the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Crypto Locker is a form of which of the following?
questions.solution:
**Correct Answer 1. Ransomware**

CryptoLocker ransomware is a file-encrypting ransomware, which encrypts the personal documents found on victim's computer using RSA-2048 key (AES CBC 256-bit encryption algorithm), then displays a message which offers to decrypt the data if a payment of about 2.05 Bitcoins, or approximately $1300 is made.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

**Let us explain each term:**

**Ransomware:** Ransomware is a type of malicious software (malware) that encrypts a user's data.

 
• The attacker then demands a ransom from the victim to restore access to the data upon payment.
 
• CryptoLocker is a notorious example of this type of malware.
 
• It propagates usually via malicious email attachments and when activated, encrypts certain types of files on the system using RSA public key cryptography, with the private key stored only on the malware's control servers.
 
• The malware then displays a message which offers to decrypt the data if a payment (through either Bitcoin or a pre-paid cash voucher) is made by a stated deadline.

 

**Adware:** Adware is a type of software that automatically delivers advertisements. It is usually unwanted, as it can be intrusive and harm your computer.

 
• Some adware can also be a form of spyware—programs designed to monitor users' web browsing to display unwanted advertisements.
 
• However, not all adware has malicious intent and some businesses genuinely use it as a method for generating advertising revenue.

 

**Spyware: **Spyware is a type of malware that is installed on a computer without the user's knowledge in order to collect their personal information, details about their internet usage, and other important data.

 
• Spyware is used for many purposes.
 
• Usually, it aims to track and sell your internet usage data, capture your credit card or bank account information, or steal your personal identity.

 

**Worms:** A worm is a standalone malware computer program that replicates itself in order to spread to other computers.

 
• It often uses a computer network to spread itself, relying on security failures on the target computer to access it.
 
• Unlike a virus, it does not need to attach itself to an existing program.
 
• Worms almost always cause at least some harm to the network, if only by consuming bandwidth, whereas viruses almost always corrupt or modify files on a targeted computer.

questions.question:
What will the function given below return in MS-Excel 2010?

=MATCH (12, {10,13, 30, 40, 60},1)
questions.solution:
**MATCH function**

 
• The MATCH function in Excel is used to locate a specific item within a range of cells. In this case, the function is looking for the position of the number 12 in the array ten, thirteen, thirty, forty, and sixty.
 
• The MATCH function has the following syntax: =MATCH (lookup value, lookup array, [match type], lookup value).
 
• So, =MATCH (12, {10,13, 30, 40, 60},1) will return 1.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61425999087e0fff9db52baa2fa9a59de5e9651f3e5c1327f22cccf68d6f4216.png] 
 
• Here, the lookup value in this case is 12, and the lookup array is 10, 13, 30, 40, 60. The match type is set to 1, which means that the function will search the lookup array for the largest value that is less than or equal to the lookup value. Because the number 12 is less than the array's first value (10), the function returns the position of the array's first number, which is 1.
